capabilities: Rewrite a note's memo body into a structured note using a chosen template
Attach note-specific context via [!context] callouts that the LLM reads but never rewrites
Feed speech-to-text transcript files and local git commit history into transforms
Manage editable markdown templates under excaVelo/templates/ with per-template model pins
Authenticate via Claude Code CLI, an Anthropic API key, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that using Claude Code as a backend is not a documented Anthropic use case. A Korean README is available; template format and wiki config docs live in separate docs/ files.
motivation: The author wanted fragmented meeting scribbles turned into proper minutes, 1:1 summaries, or decision records "without leaving Obsidian and without copy-pasting into a chat."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn fragmented in-meeting notes into structured formats without copying text into an external AI chat.

relations.evidence: The plugin spawns your installed claude CLI as a subprocess.
Get a key at console.anthropic.com, paste into settings.
point at OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, Groq, Together, OpenRouter, etc.
relations.plugin: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, Groq, Together, OpenRouter)

requires.name: Claude Code CLI (installed and logged in)
Anthropic API key or OpenAI-compatible endpoint credentials
Claude Pro/Max subscription (for the CLI path)

summary: AI plugin that rewrites raw memos into structured notes (meeting minutes, 1:1s, decision records) using Claude or OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
